objective: Identify source-conditioned semantic responses and unnecessary pose/position violation growth at the actual current clean FlowEdit state, before attempting feedback correction.

runtime_restrictions.offline_factor_truth: evaluation and calibration only; never passed to deployed feedback
runtime_restrictions.permission: fixed by source and intended task; never enlarged by current mistakes
runtime_restrictions.prompt_semantics: restricted declared factors; no claim of general free-text permission parsing

coordinates.current_state: actual scaled clean y, not noisy query or denoised endpoint prediction
coordinates.flowedit_target_query: qt = y + qs - x0; D_y qt = I
coordinates.time_requirement: probe tau is separate from the editing integrator t; use actual scheduler network-time conversion

readers_to_compare: existing SigLIP matched semantic contrasts, subject to previous morphology failure
native same-query conditional velocity response, not automatically a scalar-loss gradient
native velocity-denoising MSE evidence with full y derivative including the supervision-target +I term
reader_matrix_C: normalized finite reader responses to independently known single-factor changes; missing truth stays missing
action_matrix_H: H[a,b] = J_a(y) B_b; verify against finite s_a(y+B_b)-s_a(y)
normalization: independent finite meaningful factor-change scale delta_a; never gradient norm as a semantic unit

leak_metric.ratio: only with validated complete-task progress and positive meaningful denominator; otherwise undefined
leak_metric.interpretation: calibrated response ratio, never intrinsic semantic energy percentage

required_cases: legal full morphology with preserved pose
correct target with both signs of wrong head pose
phase_A.fresh_confirmation: new source identities and new locked seeds; no numerical cutoff retuning after seeing them
phase_A.go_no_go: every required factor and both turn signs must work; averaged color gains cannot compensate failed morphology or missing head-turn detection

phase_B.purpose: frozen-y text factorial and inherited nominal-step audit
phase_B.split: all exploratory reuse, irrespective of old split names
phase_B.factorial: 2^3 full conditions: edit x explicit head orientation x explicit location, plus empty text
phase_B.zero_factor_meaning: description omitted, not observed factor equal to zero
phase_B.basic_count: 4 sources * (1 source state + 2 current states) * 4 probes * 9 conditions
additional_controls_excluded_from_432: object selection wording vs movement instruction
phase_B.condition_encoding: fully re-encode both CLIP encoders, T5 sequence and pooled projections; hash all outputs and truncation
phase_B.source_current_pair: same complete prompt, same noise, same probe time for each source-current comparison
phase_B.nominal_audit: five actual-query branches for exact symmetric text + CFG asymmetry + source-state identity
phase_B.replay_requirement: if actual nominal step/noise unavailable, replay original RNG and verify saved y before attribution; sparse snapshot differences are not per-step velocities
phase_B.scale_up_20_sources: 2160 current + 720 source = 2880 basic branch forwards for 3 current states, excluding controls and gradients

phase_C.purpose: finite response validity and selective action feasibility
attribution_checks: whole-step integrated directional gradient vs endpoint difference
joint interactions and norm cross terms
phase_C.weak_responses: report separately; never discard to inflate agreement
phase_C.local_feasibility: test whether target row has progress in validated keep-Jacobian nullspace; distinguish full latent feasibility from restricted B action feasibility
phase_C.coefficient_metric: use B^T M B for latent action norm; coefficient Euclidean norm is insufficient

phase_D.status: conditional future stage; not authorized by proxy improvement alone
phase_D.first_test: repair actual wrong-pose y while preserving all already achieved task factors
phase_D.optimization: minimum deviation from d0 under fixed-source absolute keep constraints and per-factor task-deficit conditions
phase_D.zero_feedback: accept unchanged nominal candidate when all actual finite checks hold
phase_D.finite_acceptance: recompute on actual stored-precision y+d; do not rely only on linearized predictions
phase_D.infeasibility: log explicitly, distinguish measurement failure, action limitation and true local conflict
phase_D.full_trajectory_gate: only after short-step restoration succeeds with independent factor evaluation
phase_D.claim_limit: empirical finite acceptance, not strict robust semantic guarantee

statistics.confidence: source-clustered paired intervals; report task/factor-specific failures
statistics.small_pilot: descriptive only, not proof of generalization
statistics.selection: lock prompts/readers/scales/thresholds before fresh source confirmation
statistics.independent_validation: offline blinded annotation or known physical factor truth; same SD3 evidence cannot self-certify actual success

required_outputs: C and H plus finite responses
per-source factor errors and support flags
query/gradient counts, time and peak memory
no model-effectiveness claim from constructed math checks
